name: standmeet
description: StandMeet — self-hostable personal AI introduction. Top-level workspace; subprojects in app/, sdk/packages/*, e2e/, backend/, builder/.

overridesWhy.pdfjs-dist: ONE copy, or the reader and its worker disagree at runtime. e2e reads PDFs two ways: pdf-parse (text) pulled 5.4.296, pdf-to-img (raster) pulled 6.2.108. pdf.js loads its worker by path at runtime, so with two copies installed the API resolved to one major and the worker to the other — 'The API version "5.4.296" does not match the Worker version "6.2.108"'. Neither library asked for a wrong version; the defect is that the pair was allowed to differ. Pinned to 6.2.108, which pdf-to-img requires. Keys here mirror pnpm.overrides — pnpm parses every key in that block as a package selector, so the reason cannot live inside it.
